strings.title: The Last Screening at Al-Nour
strings.hint: First establish that Salim lived after Nader left. Then combine the bag’s custody with lobby movements; a phone connection is not its owner’s alibi.
strings.solvedText: Farid Shahin killed Salim during the 21:18–21:21 corridor visit. Nader stole the envelope at 21:09–21:12, but N77 proves Salim lived until 21:17 and the technician’s call covers Nader afterwards. The clasp was intact when Farid received his bag at 21:15; its matching fragment beneath the victim’s sleeve connects the bag to the assault. Lobby footage identifies Farid as its uninterrupted carrier. The automatic car connection provides no personal alibi. The contract discrepancy supports motive without requiring a claim that he planned to leave the phone. Salwa and Dalia concealed separate facts but have continuous coverage. No agreement between killer and thief is established.
strings.summary.text: After Al-Nour Cinema’s reopening screening, director Salim Naguib was found killed in his office and a takings envelope was missing. The envelope was recovered from an employee who admitted taking it. Does solving the theft solve the killing? Separate the two time windows, an object’s identity from its carrier, and a device connection from its owner’s presence.
strings.summary.victim.name: Salim Naguib
strings.summary.victim.note: His authoritarian financial management created several disputes.
strings.summary.timeline[0].l: Salim and Salwa in the office
strings.summary.timeline[3].l: Live correction of a new receipt
strings.scene.address: Al-Nour Cinema — rear office and lobby corridor
strings.scene.intro: The office has one door opening onto a short lobby corridor, with fixed bars over the vent. The projection-room stairs pass the camera point. Staff know where the cash-drawer key is kept; pieces of a broken presentation trophy lie near the desk.
strings.scene.notes[0]: No concealed entrance or gap in corridor footage.
strings.scene.notes[1]: Identify responsibility for theft and killing separately.
strings.scene.notes[2]: A fracture match identifies an object; its carrier requires separate evidence.
strings.evidence[0].title: Recovered envelope N62
strings.evidence[0].desc: The envelope recovered from Nader’s bag at 21:31 contained 6000. Salwa’s signature and a printing flaw match the earlier takings photograph. There is no evidence of planting; Nader admitted taking it. The envelope alone does not date Salim’s death.
strings.evidence[1].title: Office-corridor sequence
strings.evidence[1].desc:
21:09–21:12 Nader. No entry 21:12–21:18.
21:18–21:21 a bag carrier; this clip alone cannot identify the face.
21:23 Rami.
Continuous footage covers the only door and stairs, with no concealed person found in the access review.
strings.evidence[2].title: Correction of receipt N77
strings.evidence[2].desc: N77 was created at 21:16 with a new error: Mona Salem instead of Mona Selim. Salim responded live at 21:16:10–21:17, reading the error from the register. Nader had left at 21:12.
strings.evidence[3].title: Bag before handover
strings.evidence[3].desc: Photographs at 20:55 and 21:15 show Farid’s bag with a rectangular pale stripe and intact narrow metal clasp. The model is not unique on the market. The images date this clasp’s condition but alone cannot identify a later carrier.
strings.evidence[4].title: Clasp fragment
strings.evidence[4].desc: A fragment recovered beneath Salim’s sleeve physically fits the fracture on Farid’s bag, seized at 21:29. The edges join, rather than merely sharing a colour. This identifies the bag; the 21:15 photograph dates its intact state and lobby movements identify its carrier.
strings.evidence[5].title: Lobby and bag handover
strings.evidence[5].desc: Farid receives his bag at 21:15, heads toward the office corridor at 21:17:30 and returns to the lobby at 21:21:30 carrying it. No other person enters the corridor or stairs during that interval, and no bag exchange occurs between handover and return.
strings.evidence[6].title: Car connection record
strings.evidence[6].desc: 21:19 automatic reconnection between Farid’s phone and the car system. There was no voice call or driving. A phone left in a car can reconnect without its owner; the odometer did not change between 20:40 and seizure.
strings.evidence[7].title: Contract discrepancy
strings.evidence[7].desc: Supplier quotation 180000; Farid’s approval 260000. The unsupported 80000 difference is labelled emergency reinforcement. Salim’s message says he will present the file to the board tonight and refuses delay. Motive must be linked to Farid’s movements, not treated as proof on its own.
strings.evidence[8].title: Three continuous accounts
strings.evidence[8].desc: Nader: interactive call 21:14–21:25. Salwa: stage footage 21:15–21:24. Dalia: balcony video 21:13–21:24 showing her body and the door, with no return indoors until the shout.
strings.suspects[0].name: Nader Rizk
strings.suspects[0].relation: Unpaid wages and an overheard dispute with Salim.
strings.suspects[0].alibi: Initially denied leaving projection; continuous interaction with a technician covers 21:14–21:25.
strings.suspects[0].statement: I took the envelope because my wages were overdue. I am not saying that was lawful. I entered at 21:09 and left at 21:12; Salim was alive and told me to close the door. I lied to hide theft, not an attack.
strings.suspects[1].name: Farid Shahin
strings.suspects[1].relation: Approved an unsupported contract increase of 80000.
strings.suspects[1].alibi: Relies on his phone reconnecting to his car at 21:19.
strings.suspects[1].statement: I was near the car and did not enter the office tonight; I only delivered posters earlier. I often leave my bag at reception. Its clasp broke days ago. The phone connection proves I was outside.
strings.suspects[2].name: Salwa Amin
strings.suspects[2].relation: Concealed an earlier withdrawal of 9000, later repaid.
strings.suspects[2].alibi: On stage in continuous footage from 21:15 to 21:24.
strings.suspects[2].statement: I left the office at 21:05:30 after checking the takings. My earlier withdrawal was separate wrongdoing; I repaid it on 17 July. Do not confuse it with the 6000 envelope or Farid’s contract increase.
strings.suspects[3].name: Dalia Naguib
strings.suspects[3].relation: Opposed the land sale; her father threatened to exclude her.
strings.suspects[3].alibi: Initially claimed the ticket desk, then disclosed a front-balcony video call from 21:13 to 21:24.
strings.suspects[3].statement: I hid my call to the association organising civic opposition to the sale. The call shows me and the balcony door throughout. Our dispute does not mean I asked anyone to harm him.
strings.witnesses[0].name: Jaber Rafiq
strings.witnesses[0].statement: I issued N77 at 21:16 as Mona Salem instead of Mona Selim. I called Salim at 21:16:10; he read the incorrect name from the register and told me to retain the original and issue a replacement. We finished at 21:17. This new error could not be answered by an earlier recording.
strings.witnesses[1].name: Yasser Imran
strings.witnesses[1].statement: I was on an interactive video call with Nader from 21:14 to 21:25. I saw him at the projection controls and gave requests he answered immediately. He did not leave during the call.
strings.witnesses[2].name: Amna Walid
strings.witnesses[2].statement: I received Farid’s bag at 20:55 and returned it at 21:15. I photographed it with the screening posters both times; the clasp was intact. After handover, the filmed reception area contained no similar bag.
strings.witnesses[3].name: Rami Hilal
strings.witnesses[3].statement: I went to the office at 21:23, found Salim and shouted. Farid appeared from the outer parking corridor afterwards. His direction of arrival does not tell me where he was earlier.
strings.folders[0].name: Office-access review
strings.folders[0].docs[0].title: 34-D1 — Office-access review
strings.folders[0].docs[0].body: The office has one door and a fixed barred vent. A joint 20:55 tour checked the cupboard and room with no hidden person. Salim and Salwa were inside at 21:05; she left at 21:05:30. Afterwards the corridor records only Nader, the bag carrier and Rami. Staff access to the drawer key does not identify the killer.
strings.folders[1].name: The theft admission and its limits
strings.folders[1].docs[0].title: 34-D2 — The theft admission and its limits
strings.folders[1].docs[0].body: Nader admitted taking 6000 between 21:09 and 21:12. Unpaid wages do not authorise taking cash, but the admission does not include killing. His claim to have left Salim alive is checked against independent N77 evidence, not merely accepted on his word.
strings.folders[2].name: Dalia’s civic objection
strings.folders[2].docs[0].title: 34-D3 — Dalia’s civic objection
strings.folders[2].docs[0].body: Complete messages concern a petition and board attendance opposing the land sale. They contain no instruction to harm Salim. Hiding the call explains her initial location lie; the call recording covers the critical period.
strings.folders[3].name: Three different sums
strings.folders[3].docs[0].title: 34-D4 — Three different sums
strings.folders[3].docs[0].body: Salwa withdrew 9000 on 14 July and repaid it on 17 July, verified by the bank. 6000 was in envelope N62 taken on the incident night. 80000 was the discrepancy in Farid’s contract approval. Do not merge these sums into one transaction without evidence.
strings.folders[4].name: The changing clasp account
strings.folders[4].docs[0].title: 34-D5 — The changing clasp account
strings.folders[4].docs[0].body: Farid first said it broke days ago, then perhaps after leaving the cinema, then suggested someone borrowed his bag. The 21:15 image shows it intact and connects to continuous possession without exchange until he left the corridor. No evidence establishes an actual loan.
strings.folders[5].name: Earlier argument and attendance
strings.folders[5].docs[0].title: 34-D6 — Earlier argument and attendance
strings.folders[5].docs[0].body: The raised voices before 21:10 concern Nader’s wage dispute; they do not timestamp death. Other staff are accounted for in the auditorium and ticket area after 21:05, with no blackout or concealed entrance. Farid’s later presence near parking does not erase his earlier passage.
strings.reports[0].title: 34-R1 — Assault findings
strings.reports[0].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[0].body: Death resulted from a direct blunt assault consistent with the broken trophy, not a natural event coinciding with theft. N77 and the 21:23 discovery bound the interval, narrowed by corridor movements; no false minute-precise medical estimate is offered.
strings.reports[1].title: 34-R2 — Fragment and bag custody
strings.reports[1].author: Investigation and examination team
strings.reports[1].body: The fragment was recovered and sealed separately before examination of Farid’s bag seized at 21:29. Examination recorded the complementary fracture edges. Carrier identity was not inferred from colour or bag-model resemblance.
